QuestInfo.0: #b#p9000021##k wants to send a gift to #b#p9001105##k for the year of the rabbit.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9000021##k wants to send a gift to #b#p9001105##k for the year of the rabbit. Collect #b20 Striped Luck Pouches (I)#k from #bLv. 150 and higher monsters#k and bring them to #b#p9001105##k in the city.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k! Did you hear about #b#p9001105##k? He wants to give all the baby moon bunnies a #b#t4031947##k for the new year. It will be hard for #p9001105##k to gather enough for all the moon bunnies on his own, #h0#. Perhaps you could help him out?

yes.0: I hear level 151 and higher monsters tend to carry a #b#t4031947##k or two with them. If you gather #b20#k and bring bring them to #b#p9001105##k, I'm sure he'll be grateful.

no.0: Oh, I sure hope he doesn't get a hernia working on this by himself...

1.0: Gaga said you wanted to help this old bunny out. Did you bring all of them?

yes.0: Thank you! I might want your help again later, if you've got time. I have so many grandchildren...
